pr_title: Clean up .blend importer to fix unreachable code paths
pr_body:
There were some checks to see if the options included certain enums, and also check if they weren't zero. If they were present and not zero, they were checked against zero _again_, creating unreachable code paths. The unreachable path for skinning options wasn't even setting the correct arguments, now that it's reachable I fixed that too.
Closes #66836.
pr_comments: I'm not able to technical review promptly now, but I support this idea. If the test plan of checking that every single option in blender works and gives the correct result. This can be merged.
Well, a little late on that, but seems to be ok :)

comments:
I didn't notice that when writing the PR.
It _does_ work correctly, there's just some redundant checks and as a result, some code paths that can't be reached. Looking further, the same issue is there for the skinning and materials checks too. The skins one is especially bad since the second check that's never true sets the wrong arguments.
I can make another PR real quick to clean this up.

review_comments: I'm not familiar with mesh skinning in Blender but it's not 100% clear to me how the enum values match the used options. I assume that if `export_skins` is `False` then `export_all_influences` isn't used at all?
@julienduroure I think that's correct, but maybe you have something to add.

That is correct, it's an option related to skinning, so if skinning is disabled it has no effect.
In the exporter it's grayed out if skinning is off:
![Screenshot_20221004_123232](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/44414418/193875174-22bb02ec-feb2-4671-bbb0-210a55d30ee8.png)
Also this is the same arguments as the `else` statement that it was going to before. I made sure to test all the options, they work as expected.
